CC020-D1: An envelope of protest obstruction, checkpoint control and tightening aid restrictions. Medical and family passage occurred, and ordinary passage in May/June was contested. August 18 is a last confirmation, not a reopening. Envelope length is not days fully closed.

ICRC directly records aid delivery through Lachin on 18 September 2023. On 24 September, EFE reported the first group of refugees arriving in Armenia through the corridor with Russian peacekeeper accompaniment. These are different scoped access observations: aid entry and outward refugee passage. They do not establish a first ordinary two-way reopening, uninterrupted access thereafter, or continued closure to the present.
